tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: the pale blue-white ground of samstone.studio.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles on ground, always with a line border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on ground or surface. Also the background of inverted panels (decision ledger, contact block), so they flip to light in the dark theme.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: section intros, role lines, stat labels, footnotes. Passes 4.5:1 on ground, surface and accent-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the primary button, the second sentence of a headline, stat numbers, eyebrow labels, and "Studio" in the wordmark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft panels: the stats band and the "How I actually work" note. Text on it is ink, muted or accent.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and rows, and card borders. Borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Fixed navy that does not change with theme: Instagram post grounds and the background for the dark wordmark. Same value as ink in the light theme.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Logo blue: the avatar circle, the favicon and occasional Instagram cover slides. White text on it is 5.2:1. Never for body text.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Main text on brand-navy: Instagram headlines, "Sam Stone" in the dark wordmark.

tokens.name: on-navy-accent
tokens.usage: Accent on brand-navy: the second half of an Instagram headline, "Studio" in the dark wordmark, the dot in the post mark.

tokens.name: on-navy-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on brand-navy: Instagram sublines and the samstone.studio label.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: You have the vision. I'll build the product.
styles.usage: The page headline only. Scales down to 40px on phones. Second sentence in accent.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: From your idea to a working product

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Live-text wordmark in the site header, with "Studio" at weight 400 in accent. Everywhere else use the SVG files.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers, in accent, with a meta label under them at 13px.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Head of Product · December 2017 to May 2026
styles.usage: Role lines, navigation, footer and labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Short uppercase labels on cards, in accent. The only uppercase text in the system; use sparingly.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I'm Sam Stone. I turn founders' ideas into real, working products, fast.
styles.usage: The intro paragraph under a headline, and case-study intros.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: AI makes writing code fast. The expensive mistakes are still the decisions, so those come first.
styles.usage: Default reading text. 18px on phones. Keep lines under about 36em.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: For bigger builds I lead product and architecture and bring in developers I've worked with before.

styles.name: post-headline
styles.usage: Headline on a 1080 × 1350 post, in on-navy, with the second half in on-navy-accent.

styles.name: post-subline
styles.sample: I turn founders' ideas into working products.
styles.usage: One or two lines under the headline, in on-navy-soft.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, such as a role line under its title.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between a label and its value; inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a card's eyebrow, title and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between related paragraphs; gaps inside tiles.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and tile grid gaps; page side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: From a section heading to its content. Also the minimum height of any control.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Column gap between a section heading and its intro; hero column gap.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding, top and bottom (56px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Focus outlines and small highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles and soft panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large inverted panels: the contact block and the decision ledger (the current site draws the ledger at 14px).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The avatar circle.

layout.note: Fixed sizes for pages and posts.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content, centred, with space-5 side padding.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for body text.

tokens.name: post-width
tokens.usage: Instagram post width.

tokens.name: post-height
tokens.usage: Instagram post height (4:5).

tokens.name: post-margin
tokens.usage: Inner margin on Instagram posts. Keeps text inside the profile grid's 3:4 crop.
